run_pilot_task: run the pilot task script to launch a crowdsourcing vision annotation pilot task via mephisto
validate_answers: validate pilot task answers by checking that q1Answer through q4Answer all equal true
validate_unit: validate a submitted unit by extracting worker answers and granting block or allowlist qualifications
create_test_script_config: create a TestScriptConfig dataclass with hydra defaults for the static HTML blueprint and EC2 architect
setup_shared_static_task_state: setup a SharedStaticTaskState with a unit submission validator and block qualification to prevent repeat workers
